title: Radioactive Feedback: Tracing Models Trained by Label-Only LLM Supervision
abstract: arXiv:2610.15685v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conventional distillation transfers capability through teacher-generated demonstrations. LLM-as-a-Judge knowledge distillation offers a distinct and increasingly practical alternative. In the label-only variant studied here, the student generates every response and improves from scalar scores alone. Prior work shows that this non-demonstrative feedback can improve student capability, but it creates a fundamentally different provenance problem. No teacher-generated answer enters the student's training set, so any evaluator-specific trace must pass through a low-bandwidth reward signal rather than copied text. Existing watermarks and distillation detectors do not cover this score-only channel. We introduce Radioactive Feedback, which encodes a registered pattern of behavioral preferences in the rewards themselves. The evaluator applies bounded pointwise adjustments to quality-qualified responses, allowing repeated optimization to transfer

translated_title: 放射性反馈：追踪由仅标签式LLM监督训练的模型
translated_abstract: 传统的知识蒸馏通过教师生成的示范来传递能力，而“LLM作为评判者”的知识蒸馏提供了一种独特且日益实用的替代方案。在本文研究的仅标签变体中，学生模型生成所有响应，并仅从标量分数中改进。先前的工作表明，这种非示范性反馈可以提升学生模型的能力，但它带来了一个根本不同的溯源问题：没有任何教师生成的答案进入学生的训练集，因此任何评估器特有的痕迹必须通过低带宽的奖励信号而非复制的文本来传递。现有的水印和蒸馏检测方法无法覆盖这种仅分数通道。我们提出了放射性反馈，它在奖励信号本身中编码一种注册过的行为偏好模式。评估器对符合质量要求的响应施加有界的逐点调整，使得重复优化能够传递……
tldr: 提出“放射性反馈”方法，通过在奖励信号中嵌入注册的行为偏好模式，实现了对仅由标签式LLM监督（无教师示范文本）训练的模型的溯源追踪。
en_tdlr: Proposes Radioactive Feedback, which encodes a registered pattern of behavioral preferences in the reward signals themselves, enabling tracing of models trained by label-only LLM supervision without any teacher-generated text.
